description: Spatial composition: two equal circles in a symmetric relationship.
prompt: Write a GLSL ES 3.0 fragment shader implementing mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord). iResolution (vec3) and iTime (float) are provided; do not redeclare them and do not write main(). Use normalized bottom-left coordinates. Requirements: (1) draw exactly two filled white circles centered at (0.30, 0.50) and (0.70, 0.50); (2) both radii are 0.13 of frame height; (3) the midpoint between them remains near-black; (4) use hard edges and a near-black background; (5) the shader is static and ignores iTime; (6) no NaN output.
